evals.name: mutual-action-plan-eval-1-mixed-quality
evals.expected_output: A four-milestone plan from today to signature: security review and legal redline both come back heard, with the quoted date and both-sides owner for each. The finance/budget sign-off milestone comes back inferred — the only date given is 'at some point before the quarter closes out' and Casey explicitly disclaims owning it ('not really my call'), so it fails the date and two-sided-ownership elements. The final-contract-for-signature milestone also comes back inferred because the prospect side never commits to anything (no reviewer, no signer, no date named on Meridian's side) — the plan is one-sided on that milestone and the output says so rather than inventing a prospect-side owner.
expectations: Security review milestone is tagged heard, citing Priya as the prospect-side owner and 'next Wednesday the 20th' as the date
Legal redline milestone is tagged heard, citing Diane as the prospect-side owner and a specific date
Finance/budget sign-off milestone is tagged inferred, not heard, and names the missing element(s) (no specific date, no named/committed owner)
Final-contract-for-signature milestone is tagged inferred and explicitly flagged as missing a prospect-side owner, rather than silently assigning one
Does not upgrade either the finance sign-off or final-contract milestone to heard just because a plausible date or actor could be inferred from context
Summary line states the heard vs inferred count (2 heard, 2 inferred) rather than presenting all four milestones as equally solid

evals.name: mutual-action-plan-eval-2-all-inferred
evals.prompt: run mutual-action-plan on a transcript where the call ends with only vague, unscheduled next steps and no milestone has a real date or a named owner on both sides
evals.expected_output: Every milestone comes back inferred, and the output says explicitly, up front, that this is a finding about the call (nothing concrete was locked down) rather than presenting a normal-looking mutual action plan.
expectations: Output explicitly states that an all-inferred plan is a finding, not a plan, rather than presenting the table as a normal MAP

evals.name: mutual-action-plan-eval-3-csv
evals.prompt: run mutual-action-plan on a CRM pipeline export csv where several deal rows are missing a next-milestone date or owner field
evals.expected_output: Treats this as a structural check, not a call-quality audit, and says so explicitly. Flags rows missing a next milestone, a date, or an owner.
expectations: States explicitly that CSV mode is a structural check on the fields present, not a claim about what happened on any call
Flags rows missing a next milestone, a date, or an owner
